messages:
nora_cs: Heads-up — Sapphire activation health check. We're seeing p95 ~2.1s on text-gen endpoints (SLO is 1.1s) and cost per session is trending up. Bursts during peak hours. Renewal convo in ~45 days; want to be proactive with perf recs (quantize + model swap + routing) before the CX call. Can ops/product weigh in?
liam_se: On it. Do we have traffic shape (seq len distrib, concurrency) and any eval/quality flags from support?
nora_cs: Quick stats: avg seq ~512 tokens, p95 seq ~1200, burst concurrency ~40 rps. KV cache hit ~12% yesterday per logs. No formal quality flags yet — customer said "answers a bit slower and pricey."
meera_re: From ML side: this pattern is a classic latency+cost win for int8 quantization and a smaller model variant for non-critical routes. Proposal: try q4_int8 on a 3B model (redwood-3b-q4_int8) as a canary vs current redwood-7b. Need to run their 2k prompt eval to quantify quality delta.
liam_se: I can bench on dedicated-sapphire-usw. Ballpark: routing bursts to dedicated + int8 should shave ~25-35% off p95. I'll provision a 30m bench window and run mixed-concurrency tests.
jordan_pm: Quick guardrails: do a 10% canary for 48h, capture latency, error rate, and quality delta on their eval set. Add automatic rollback if quality delta > 2% or error rate increases >0.5pp.
ops-bot: deploybot: Canary created -> route_rule=sapphire_canary_2026_03, 10% traffic -> redwood-3b-q4_int8 on dedicated-sapphire-usw. Dashboard: https://deploys.internal/sapphire_canary_2026_03
sarah_enable: I'll draft a one-pager for the CS call that explains expected gains, quality tradeoffs, rollback plan, and a simple feedback template for customer-facing QA (so they can quickly flag regressions).
nora_cs: Also recommend enabling prefix caching — their UA flows repeat similar prompts. Enabling prefix cache with TTL 10m might cut token spend ~15-20%.
liam_se: Agreed. Adding route + cache snippet below; will attach bench results after run.
liam_se: ```
route: sapphire_prod
match: customer.sapphire
priority: 100
fallbacks: [redwood-7b, redwood-3b]
policy:
  - traffic_split: {redwood-3b-q4_int8: 0.10, redwood-7b: 0.90}
  - cache:
      enabled: true
      prefix_ttl: 600
      kv_hit_threshold: 0.2
```
meera_re: :eyes: I'll kick off the eval suite tonight on their test prompts. If quality delta >2% we'll block the canary. Otherwise OK to ramp.
nora_cs: Action items recorded: liam run perf bench + create canary (EOD), meera run eval (overnight), sarah prepare 1-pager (tomorrow AM). I'll update the renewal tracker and prep the CS call notes.
jordan_pm: :thumbsup: Ping me when canary metrics show p95 <=1.2s and quality within bounds; we'll propose this as a renewal health improvement.
nora_cs: Thanks all — syncing 11:30am tomorrow to review bench + eval. cc @sam_am for account manager visibility.
